apikey.description: Splunk Observability API Key. Will pull from `OBSERVABILITY_API_TOKEN` environment variable if available.

apiurl.description: Splunk Observability Realm API Endpoint (E.G. `https://api.<REALM>.signalfx.com`). Will pull from `API_URL` environment variable if available.

realm.description: Splunk Observability Realm (E.G. `us1`). Will pull from `REALM` environment variable if available. For Rigor use realm rigor

block.description: Unique elements of a given request. See official [API documentation](https://dev.splunk.com/observability/reference/api/synthetics_api_tests/latest#endpoint-createapitest) as the source of truth for descriptions and options for these values.

selector.description: Shorthand for the first selector when selectors is not used.

selector_type.description: Shorthand for the first selector when selectors is not used.

block.description: Element locators for this step (1-10). When set, this is sent to the API as the selectors array. selector and selector_type are still supported as a shorthand for a single locator.
